text.p: Liquefied gas producer Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Wednesday it had completed the refinancing of its current credit facility of US$1.45 billion.
"A facility of US$1.2 billion has been signed with nine Australian and international banks," Woodside said.
"Following drawdown under the new facility and some further repayment of current debt, the currently outstanding debt is expected to reduce to US$850 million," it said.
"The new facility comprises two tranches (a US$950 million, five year tranche and a US$250 million seven year tranche) with interest rates at margins over LIBOR."
It did not specify the margins.
Woodside, about 40 percent owned by the Royal Dutch Shell Group, operates the North-West Shelf gas field off Western Australia.
